title: AMA with Mistress Calia
description:
Answering questions from my listeners! Tune in and learn more about me!

Answering questions from my listeners! Tune in and learn more about me!

I had a great time answering your questions, so stick around until the end to hear everything… I might have even left a little surprise for you…

CW: Covert hypnosis (Covert hypnosis script included below with Q&A for the curious wanting to learn more about me, Hypno Mistress Calia!)

Hi everyone, welcome to my ask me anything, one of the rewards unlocked for supporting my holiday fundraiser. Thank you so much for donating, and if you want, you can still support the cause! Link is in the description! And don’t forget to subscribe to me on patreon to hear more of me, link’s down there too!

Now, on to the questions.

Amaroq asks: Do you have a cat?

Nope, I’m more of a dog person actually!

Hero asks: Have You ever used Your natural dominance to overcome a manager at work to get Your desired outcome?

Not intentionally… I try to keep things professional, sorry for ruining the fantasy!

Knobi asks: May I ask your age?

No, you may not ask a lady her age! I’m old enough to know better, and that’s as much as I’ll say.

Orange asks: How did you get into this whole thing?

So I’ve always been interested in psychology and sexuality, and this is basically the meeting point of those two things, and that got me reading and learning more and trying things out, eventually I thought I’d give it a go for fun on Youtube.

Ossington asks:

What’s the divide like between Mistress Calia and Civilian Calia? Is it like Superman and Clark Kent where you try to be just your average woman or are you hypnotising people left and right into paying for lunch?

It’s basically that but I don’t wear glasses. Well… sometimes for sexy reasons because they look cute. But I’m very serious and professional by day!

Minusman asks: What kind of student were you?

Quiet and studious definitely, I like to learn! You probably want me to say I was a bratty, naughty girl but sorry, I was more nerdy at school.

Brady asks: What made you decide this is what you wanted to do in life?

Well, it’s a hobby really. I have a job but I love to write and create and I like kinky, sexy things so this is a perfect way for me to explore my creative side.

Thomas asks: Do you write your own scripts? and Do you write commercially in other creative outlets?

Yes I write my own scripts, and I’ve written for fun but never for publication, so this is my most successful effort yet I suppose!

Knobi asks: Do you want to conquer twitter?

Yes, definitely. I’m gunning to take over as CEO so I can stop calling it X.

Knobi asks: Where do you see yourself in 5 years?

Atop a throne of submissive followers… I suppose by then it’ll be 6 years of creating this hypnosis content so I want the youtube plaque by then for 100,000 subscribers.

Lamia asks: Mistress as we all know red is your favorite color, so is the vampire audio there to trick us into thinking you’re just roleplaying and aren’t an actual vampire? i’m onto you…

So, this is why I won’t reveal my age, because it would give away my secret identity as a thousand year old vampire.

River asks: After attempting to hypnotize your way out of a parking ticket, you are sadly given the death penalty  What would your last meal look like? You can have any number of courses and there are no limits with regards to where the food comes from or who prepares it. Nostalgic sweets, a favourite chipper that closed down, nothing is off limits!

Christmas dinner! Turkey and ham and gravy and roast potatoes…

Noble asks: What was your most interesting experience regarding hypnosis?

I mean, finding a community of like-minded people who love what I make is a lovely surprise really. Non-sexy answer but… it’s the most interesting thing.

Alex asks: What’s your process of creating and writing a file from idea all the way to publishing? And what’s your favourite part of it?

Ok let me give you an example of a file I have planned for this one.

Phase one is ideation – inspiration comes from talking to people, movies, tv shows, books, even just random events. So I had this one idea to do a simple musical loop as induction, because I was listening to a song like that.

Then research – how does that work? I can’t play much music, and I wanted it to be a bass loop, so I had to go find out how to make that, and what makes music work and… that’s when things start to expand a bit and I need a brief intro to music theory and psychology to find out what key to use and then suddenly I’m playing with a sequencer and I want it to be a bigger file…

Then using that info I’ll write a script of a few thousand words, then sit down and record it a few days later. Usually two or three takes per script until I’m happy.

After that, pass one of editing to remove mistakes, background noise, and add some light effects like compression and filters.

Then second editing step is building a multitrack of layered audio, sound effects, music, and whatever else I need.

After that’s done, export the file, make thumbnail and video versions for landscape and portrait platforms, and upload to Youtube, patreon, spotify, tiktok and wherever else.

Pinkie asks: If you could have any one superpower that isn’t related to hypno in any way what would it be and why?

Teleportation so I could travel really easily anywhere in the world.

Enderdrone asks: Why do Irish love potatoes so much and do you have potatoes in every cooking dish?

Because potatoes are easy to grow here, and for political and historical reasons, other carbohydrate sources were difficult to come by, so potatoes were grown extensively. We’ve somewhat expanded our palette since then so meals are pretty varied now, but I do enjoy potatoes in their many forms.

Pinkie asks: What is your shoe size?

I’m a UK 5

Ghosty asks: How long were you planning to get into this sort of business or did it just happen as a “spur of the moment” kind of thing?

I almost did it about 6 months before starting and got cold feet, spent more time planning, and came back when I was happy.

Lightdragonslayer asks: Favourite movie?

Muppet Christmas Carol

Slop asks: Skill or talent you want to learn?

Rope tying, knots and that sort of thing for um… for yachting, yeah.

Minusman asks: With so many willing and eager subs who get pleasure from concepts like brainwashing and slavery (including me!) how do you approach the ethics of this power dynamic??

I just try to avoid anything potentially dangerous, and am a big believer there’s an onus on the dominant to care for the submissive in any scene.

Ruy asks: favourite crisp flavour

Cheese and onion.

Waitn4atrain asks: What is…the airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow?

What do you mean? An African or European swallow?

Lamia asks: Do you have any formal training in psychology?

Yes I’ve spent some time in college learning it, but not to degree level.

Yvette asks: How do you say scone?

Think I just answered that.

Che asks: What is your favorite mindscape you’ve placed yourself or others into?

I did a file where the listener travels inside their own brain. I liked that a lot. Kinda trippy fun.

Anchiceratops asks: What did you major in during undergrad?

Business

Lunar asks: What’s your advice on growing an online following?

Be consistent with producing content or posting. Create a schedule and don’t break it.

Jon asks: What is your favourite femdom or role play scenario?

Definitely being a supervillain, I’ve loved recording files on that theme and it’s just so sexy to be the allpowerful evil girl taking over the world.

Raptor asks: What do you like about hypnosis or being a Mistress?

I like the idea of taking control of someone’s mind, of getting into their head and turning the dial that amps up their kinks and leaves them desperate for more.

Jim asks: How do you hypnotize someone?

You really need to get them to focus on something. It can be an object or even just your voice. It could be listening to a lot of answers to a lot of questions.

Kinklover asks: Why are you so powerful?

Well, I can get into people’s minds, find ways to worm my way in, sometimes all it takes is the right combination of words, or a snap of my fingers, but eventually, they listen to me enough that they can’t help but fall under my spell.

Hypnodoubt asks: Can anyone really be hypnotized?

Of course. Trance is a state we enter every day. An intense feeling of focus. Like you’re now focusing on my voice, only my voice. Paying close attention to learn more and more about me, to hear all my important answers to these questions. My words are important, so you just have to focus on them.

Caliaiscool asks: So you just tell me to drop and I do?

Not quite, you see you have to focus on my words and get ready to drop first. Get ready for it by relaxing. Taking a long, deep breath, closing your eyes. Getting comfortable. Then when I tell you to drop down into a trance, you’ll fall deeply for me.

Mindlessone asks: Should I listen only to you?

Yes, listen only to me, listen to my words, my very important words as you relax now, relax your body. Let your muscles become limp and restful as your eyes shut and you slow your breathing. Deep breath in now, long and slow, hold it, and let it out.

Intranced asks: Am I falling under your power?

You are falling under my power, falling deeper with every moment, and soon you’ll drop down into a trance, a relaxing, wonderful trance where my important words will fill your mind, they’ll be all that matters. You’ve loved listening and learning more about me, and now you really want my words to fill your mind completely. To wrap around your brain and take hold of you.

Enslaved asks: Why am I feeling sleepy?

You’re falling now, falling down into a state of relaxation, a state of calm and peace and openness, where your mind will be blank and my words will become your thoughts.

Emptymind asks: I am ready to fall Mistress.

Good, then drop for me. Drop down into a trance and feel my words become your thoughts. My voice fills your mind and nothing else matters now, nothing but my words, nothing but my voice. Nothing else but your intense focus on my important words.

Now I’m going to ask you the questions. I want to ask you anything and you’ll answer honestly.

You can just nod your head if the answer is yes, or shake it if the answer is no, but if the answer is more than that, leave a comment, won’t you?

Good, and let me ask you anything now as you focus only on me, relaxing deeper with each question now.

Are you in a trance?

Good, are you under my control?

That’s right, are you mindless and open?

I know you are, are you listening only to my words?

That’s it, perfect, and are you ready to obey my every command?

Good, doing so well for me and dropping down deeper with each question you answer.

Do you obey Mistress Calia?

Yes you do, do you want to surrender to me?

I know, do you find me completely fascinating?

Of course you do… Will you let my words become your thoughts?

Good, and when you awaken from this trance, will you feel refreshed and happy, but forget that you fell under my spell?

I know you will. Very good.

Now before you do that, one more question for you to answer, one very important question you must answer. Why do you follow me and listen to my files? Tell me, leave a comment and tell me. Very good, that’s right, just tell me why you love the sound of my voice and the words I speak, why they’re so so important… tell me why you need to listen to everything I say and fall under my spell over and over.

That’s it, and feel so good having done that, so happy and satisfied you’ve done as I commanded. You have pleased me and it makes you feel so happy. I know it does. It feels good to please me.

And you can please me again by waking up now, forgetting all about this trance, and waking up.

Awaken, awaken for me and feel refreshed and happy.

Awaken… that’s right.

Thank you for listening! I hope I answered all your questions and you know lots more about me now. This was really fun! Let’s do it again some time ok?

See you soon!

Oh and thanks again for donating!
author: Mistress Calia
